name: dsh-testkit
desc_en: Lifecycle conformance testing for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
desc_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 插件的生命周期一致性测试工具。

name: dsh-task-control
desc_en: Pause, resume and cancel long-running DSH tasks with safe and forced pause modes.
desc_zh: 为 DSH 长任务提供暂停、恢复和取消控制，支持安全暂停与强制暂停。

name: anime-find
desc_en: DeepSeek Harness anime-search plugin: search anime across multiple sources in-chat, show Bangumi ratings and details in cards, and copy magnet links.
desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 搜番插件：对话内多源搜索番剧，卡片展示 Bangumi 评分与详情，支持复制磁力。

name: dsh-token-billing
desc_en: Real-time token billing plugin for DSH: bill at the official CNY price, auto-switch peak/off-peak (Beijing time), prices auto-follow the official site, visual custom model pricing.
desc_zh: DSH 实时 token 计费插件：官网人民币价直接计费、高峰/错峰自动切换、价格实时跟随官网、可视化自定义模型价格。

name: dsh-voice-input-plugin
desc_en: DeepSeek Harness composer voice-control plugin: a minimal linear mic button in the composer tool row; tap to start continuous monitoring with speech streaming live into the draft, send anytime.
desc_zh: DSH 输入框语音控制插件：在 composer 工具行放一个极简线性麦克风按钮，点按进入持续监听，语音实时流入草稿，随时发送。

name: DSH-changeproof
desc_en: Change-proof verification: plan a rollback package before edits, verify the actual changes against it, and track verification status.
desc_zh: 变更证明：dsh 改代码前生成回退包（涉及文件/commit/关键代码块），改后逐项对账，随时查看验证状态。

name: DSH-arena
desc_en: Local-first experiment and evaluation workbench: run one task across candidate models, compare the matrix, Pareto frontier, winner, and audit alerts.
desc_zh: 本地优先的实验与评估工作台：同题多候选模型对比，成绩单/帕累托前沿/建议胜者/审计告警，数据全在本地，总开关+每模型独立开关控耗。

name: deepseek-harness-live-preset-switch
desc_en: Live agent-preset switching at turn boundaries for DeepSeek Harness
desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话中实时切换预设

name: dsh-compact-activity
desc_en: DSH Web UI plugin: folds consecutive thinking/tool-call messages into a single collapsed one-line disclosure, keeping official components when expanded.
desc_zh: DSH Web UI 插件：把连续的思考/工具调用消息折叠成一行可展开的单行披露，展开时保留官方组件。

name: dsh-plugin-qcc
desc_en: Dynamic Cordis plugin that brings the Qichacha (企查查) enterprise data source into a DSH session — 5 agent tools (auth, company search, knowledge search) plus a settings-page QR login.
desc_zh: 将企查查企业数据源接入 DSH 会话的动态 Cordis 插件——5 个 agent 工具（认证、企业搜索、知识搜索）及设置页二维码登录。

name: DshCockpit
desc_en: Electron desktop cockpit for dsh web: tray-resident background tasks, token/cost tracking with budget alarms, runtime auto-update with rollback, Quick Ask hotkey, scheduled tasks, full-text session search
desc_zh: dsh web 桌面驾驶舱：托盘常驻后台任务、Token 用量与成本统计（预算报警）、运行时自动更新与回滚、Quick Ask 全局热键、定时任务、会话全文检索

name: dsh-archive-manager
desc_en: Archived-session manager for DeepSeek Harness WebUI — view, reopen, unarchive, or permanently delete archived sessions
desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness WebUI 归档会话管理插件：查看归档、继续对话、恢复归档、彻底删除

name: dsh-frontend-tools
desc_en: Bridge web/Electron/Tauri/Node applications to DeepSeek Harness agents in real time — expose frontend tools to AI over loopback WebSocket, with read-only/write classification for human approval
desc_zh: 桥接 Web/Electron/Tauri/Node 应用到 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，通过本地 WebSocket 将前端工具暴露给 AI，支持只读/写入分类的人工审批机制

name: dsh-autonomy
desc_en: Switch between Chat and Agent without leaving your DeepSeek Harness session.
desc_zh: 无需离开当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话即可在 Chat 与 Agent 模式间切换。

name: dsh-contrib-topology
desc_en: DSH plugin that renders a live dependency-topology graph of the running agent — plugin/service nodes, depends-on/provides/contains/disabled edges, and fiber lifecycle phases.
desc_zh: 渲染运行中 agent 的实时依赖拓扑图：插件/服务节点、depends-on/provides/contains/disabled 边与 fiber 生命周期阶段。

name: dsh-prompt-order-fix
desc_en: Deterministic system-prompt section ordering for DeepSeek Harness — fixes KV-cache invalidation from unstable same-order section ordering across restarts.
desc_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定的 system-prompt section 排序——修复跨重启因同序 section 排序漂移导致的 KV 缓存失效。

name: TMCRA-Agent-Memory
desc_en: Scope-isolated, graph-based long-term memory engine for AI agents, with a DeepSeek Harness technical preview.
desc_zh: 作用域隔离、基于图结构的 AI 智能体长期记忆引擎，含 DeepSeek Harness 技术预览接入。

name: dsh-splash-launcher
desc_en: One-click Windows launcher for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web GUI with a stroke-by-stroke startup animation.
desc_zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Windows 一键启动器：无边框描边动画 + 后台拉起 dsh web，关窗自动停服务。

name: dsh-anthropic-fonts
desc_en: Switch the DSH web interface to Anthropic Sans Web Text and model conversation to Anthropic Serif Web Text.
desc_zh: 给 DSH Web 界面换上 Anthropic 字体：界面用 Anthropic Sans，对话用 Anthropic Serif，代码用 Anthropic Mono。

name: dsh-movein
desc_en: Move your whole Claude Code setup into DeepSeek Harness with one command (skills, slash commands, MCP, hooks, subagents, permission rules); dry-run inventory by default, plus doctor checkup and auto-backup in v0.5
desc_zh: 一条命令把 Claude Code 配置整套搬进 DSH（技能、斜杠命令、MCP、hooks、子代理、权限规则），默认 dry run 出搬家清单，v0.5 新增 doctor 体检与自动备份

name: dsh-win32
desc_en: Get DSH Minimal mode working on Windows: persistent Git Bash PTY in one command, usable inside sandbox too
desc_zh: 让 DSH 极简模式在 Windows 上真正可用：一行装好持久 Git Bash PTY，沙箱内也能用

name: dsh-guard-mode
desc_en: Safe-guard mode: full-access capability plus a blocklist scan on shell commands (one-time human approval on hit)
desc_zh: 安全防呆模式:FullAccess 全部能力 + 危险命令黑名单拦截,命中转单次人工批准

name: dsh-deepseek-meter
desc_en: DeepSeek official usage & balance collapsible pill (my key + account totals)
desc_zh: DeepSeek 官方用量·余额可折叠胶囊(我的 key + 账号合计)

name: dsh-ocgo-lite
desc_en: OpenCode Go usage bar for DeepSeek Harness: quota rings (rolling/weekly/monthly), real-time DSH-session token & cost stats with live official pricing, per-model and current-session scope switching, one-click API key copy.
desc_zh: OpenCode Go 用量常驻条：套餐余量圆环（滚动/周/月）+ token/花费实时统计（官方实时定价），支持本次会话/全部范围与按模型联动，一键复制 API Key。

name: dsh-compass
desc_en: Right-side context-and-files panel for the web UI: directory tree with git badges, live injected docs with compaction history, read-only git graph with workspace diffs, drag panel files into the conversation, session-log export; installs on official master source builds since v0.13.0
desc_zh: Web 界面右侧上下文文件面板：带 git 徽章的目录树、实时注入文档与压缩历史流水、只读提交图与工作区 diff、面板文件拖入对话、会话日志导出；v0.13.0 起可装在官方 master 源码构建上

name: dsh-docs-panel
desc_en: Your own Markdown notes, readable from any workspace: a slide-out docs panel for the DSH WebUI.
desc_zh: DSH WebUI 里的「随身手册」：全局 Markdown 笔记，任何工作区随时可读。

name: dsh-plugin-doctor
desc_en: DSH plugin doctor: diagnose and manage DeepSeek Harness plugins (plugin-manager).
desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件医生：诊断与管理 DSH 插件（插件管理器）。

name: dsh-token-viewer
desc_en: CC Switch-style token consumption statistics for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: per-request usage log, real-consumption hero, request-time-bucketed trend chart, per-model peak/off-peak list pricing, per-project and per-model stats, account balance.
desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端 CC Switch 风格 Token 消耗统计：按请求的用量日志、真实消耗 Hero、按请求提交时间分桶的趋势图、按模型峰谷牌价计费、项目/模型统计与账户余额。

name: dsh-oomol
desc_en: OOMOL Connector for DeepSeek Harness: progressively discovers and executes Actions from OOMOL-managed apps, with an in-app Connections panel and Provider credentials retained by OOMOL.
desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 OOMOL Connector：渐进式发现并执行由 OOMOL 管理的应用 Actions，提供应用内 Connections 面板，Provider 凭据保留在 OOMOL。

name: harness-plugin-store-optimized
desc_en: Optimized Harness plugin store: graphical browse, search and one-click install of DSH plugins, with ratings, dependency topology, audit logs and quality gates; this fork adds configurable download dir, bundle-level conflict detection, pnpm auto-detection, and upstream bug fixes.
desc_zh: Harness 插件商店优化版：图形化浏览/搜索/一键安装 DSH 插件，评分评论、依赖拓扑、审计日志、质量门；本 fork 新增可配置插件下载目录、bundle 层冲突检测、pnpm 自动寻路，并修复多项上游 bug。

name: dsh-release-guard
desc_en: Canary-release safety net for DeepSeek Harness: preset health checks, canary routing decisions, supervisor monitoring, and auto-rollback.
desc_zh: DSH 插件发布安全网：preset 健康检查、Canary 灰度决策、Supervisor 监控控制与自动回滚。

name: dsh-literature
desc_en: Literature search and tracking for DeepSeek Harness: Crossref + arXiv, ORCID researcher disambiguation, SCI journal catalog, and a 文献跟踪助理 agent preset.
desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 文献检索与定向跟踪插件：Crossref + arXiv 检索、ORCID 研究者消歧、SCI 期刊目录、全局新库，配套「文献跟踪助理」preset。

name: dsh-plugin-nexterm
desc_en: Batch fleet-maintenance plugin for DeepSeek Harness via Nexterm: bring a Nexterm-hosted SSH fleet into a DSH session through the Nexterm REST API with model-driven tools.
desc_zh: 通过 Nexterm 进行批量运维的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：借助 Nexterm REST API 把托管 SSH 集群接入 DSH 会话，提供模型驱动的运维工具。

name: dsh-ccswitch-importer
desc_en: Import CCSwitch Codex profiles into DeepSeek Harness and configure per-model reasoning effort on the Models page.
desc_zh: 一键导入 CCSwitch Codex 配置到 DeepSeek Harness，并在「设置 → 模型」页按模型配置推理等级。

name: dsh-what-changed
desc_en: See what the agent actually changed. Every file it wrote this session, in one review panel — review before you commit.
desc_zh: 看得见 Agent 到底改了什么。一个会话里所有文件改动，一屏看完再决定要不要提交。

name: dsh-auto-translate
desc_en: Full-pipeline Chinese translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: live translation of model reasoning as it streams, in-place Chinese below each English reply, and one-line Chinese summaries for tool outputs and tool-call glosses — a standalone provider request that never enters the session transcript.
desc_zh: dsh 网页端全链路中文翻译：思考过程实时翻译、英文回复就地中文、工具输出中文摘要与工具调用注释；翻译为独立提供方请求，不进入会话上下文。

name: dsh-context-compressor
desc_en: One-click context compression for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a 压缩 button on the session title bar summarizes the whole conversation into a few lines, opens a new session in the same workspace seeded with the summary, and switches to it — the original session stays untouched.
desc_zh: dsh 网页端一键上下文压缩：会话标题栏「压缩」按钮把整段对话总结成几句话，新建同工作区会话以摘要为第一条消息并自动切换，原会话原样保留。

name: dsh-continue-on-limit
desc_en: Auto-continue for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: when a local model hits its output-token cap and the max-tokens notice appears, the plugin automatically queues a short continue message so the reply keeps flowing — dual-source truncation detection, loop protection, and no UI.
desc_zh: dsh 网���端输出上限自动继续：本地模型输出到上限出现提示时，自动发送「继续」让回复接上；双源截断检测、防死循环保护，完全无 UI。

name: dsh-commander
desc_en: Commander mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a one-click session header button injects a protocol brief into the session, then parses and auto-executes task blocks in the model reply — separating the strategist loop from worker loops via a visible badge.
desc_zh: dsh 网页端指挥官模式：会话标题栏一键注入协议简报，解析模型回复中的任务块并自动执行，让策略层与执行层分离；通过徽章按钮激活/停用。

name: dsh-memory
desc_en: Project+global long-term memory for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: split POST /items endpoints to avoid path conflicts, tool-call context merged into memory items as compact summaries, with deduplication and session-scoped persistence.
desc_zh: dsh 网页端项目级+全局长期记忆：分拆 POST /items 路由避免路径冲突，多轮工具调用上下文压缩后存入记忆项，去重与会话级持久化。

name: dsh-login
desc_en: Login gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: requires username and password authentication before accessing the interface when the dsh-web port is opened.
desc_zh: 给 dsh-web 加一道登录门：打开 dsh-web 的端口时先要输入用户名和密码，验证通过后才能看到界面。

name: dsh-android-agent
desc_en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin: connects to Android phones via WebSocket for remote operations and automated testing.
desc_zh: dsh-web 插件，支持用 websocket 方式连接到安卓手机，执行远程操作和自动测试。

name: Deepseek-Harness-EAC
desc_en: Bundled-runtime DSH desktop client with one-click startup and 10 UI themes (EAC)
desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows/Linux 桌面端「揽尽万象 EAC」：内置 Node 运行时与完整 dsh CLI 内核，一键启动，内置 10 套 UI 主题。

name: deepseek-harness-desktop
desc_en: Tauri desktop wrapper for dsh: tiny installer, zero env setup, cross-platform
desc_zh: 基于 Tauri 的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版：安装包仅约 5MB，零环境配置（自动装配 Node 内核），预置常用插件，支持 Windows / macOS / Linux。

name: DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget
desc_en: Whale balance/usage widget pinned inside the DSH Web UI
desc_zh: 住在 DSH Web 界面右下角的小鲸鱼娘余额挂件：显示 DeepSeek API 余额、今日已用与每轮对话消耗，支持数字滚动动画与拖拽吸附，随界面自动启用；标准 DSH 插件，可用 dsh plugin 安装。

name: dsh-im
desc_en: One plugin, nine IM channels: bring bots into DeepSeek Harness
desc_zh: 通过扫码、App Manifest 或机器人凭据把 IM 机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness：一个插件统一管理飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Slack、Telegram、Discord、WhatsApp 九种渠道与 AI Office 连接器，每个渠道可接入多个机器人。

name: dsh-desktop
desc_en: Electron desktop workbench wrapping official DSH Web with bundles & worktrees
desc_zh: 以官方 DSH Web 为核心的插件化桌面工作台：精选社区 Bundle、离线 Profile、Git Worktree、文件附件与受控原生能力，组合在一个 Electron 应用中。

name: dsh-pocket
desc_en: QR-code remote access to your local dsh web from a phone
desc_zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋：电脑上跑 dsh web，手机扫码即同步访问同一界面，支持局域网与公网穿透、实时同屏。

name: dsh_desktop
desc_en: Windows/macOS client bundling full dsh runtime, now Tauri 2 based
desc_zh: 开箱即用的 DeepSeek Harness Windows/macOS 桌面客户端：内置完整 dsh 运行时与全部官方插件，免装 Node.js；v0.5.0 迁移至 Tauri 2，「守护瀑布」让坏插件/坏配置不再白屏。

name: deepseek-harness-studio
desc_en: Zero-code desktop studio: plugin market, presets and visual enhancements
desc_zh: 赋范空间出品的 DeepSeek Harness 零代码桌面增强：视觉增强、本地模型、插件市场一键安装与管理、Preset 广场与 AI 智能推荐。

name: dsh-router-standard
desc_en: Routes tasks across spec/mixed/react reasoning bands with injected personas
desc_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的任务感知推理模式路由器：spec/mixed/react 三档行为带，人格注入 + 首轮工具注入，对 Agent 可见的调节参数。

name: deepseek-design
desc_en: Generate and visually edit real design artifacts and PPT inside dsh
desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 可编辑设计系统：AI 生成、可视化持续编辑设计作品，附模板市场与 PPT 输出（npm 包 deepseek-idesign / ippt / ivideo）。

name: dsh-ios
desc_en: Live iOS Simulator + USB iPhone control as a DSH plugin (22 tools)
desc_zh: 把实时 iOS 模拟器（以及 USB 连接的真机 iPhone）搬进 DSH 对话：22 个 Agent 工具负责启动、构建、按无障碍标识/OCR/列表行驱动 UI，侧边栏提供可点按拖拽的 MJPEG 实时画面。

name: dsh-pentest
desc_en: Authorized-pentest mode for dsh with chain/vuln/asset views
desc_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的渗透测试模式（限授权场景）：记录目标、探索线索、验证结果、资产与漏洞，Web 端提供探索链路/漏洞/资产视图；自包含 bundle，可通过 dsh plugin add 安装。
